correctness.rationale: The Pauli terms give B0 Phi+ = 2 Phi+ − 2 Psi−, B0 Psi− = −2 Phi+ − 2 Psi−, and zero on the complementary Bell vectors. In the symmetric/antisymmetric block decomposition the swap difference has eigenvalues ±2||w||, giving d=2||w||. Positivity bounds d²/4<=b(1−b), fixes b in [b_−,b_+], and gives a>=|c|²/b when d>0. The positive expectation uses a<=1−b and |c|<=d/2. For the negative expectation, b−t²/b+2t, t=|c|, increases with b; after b=b_+ it increases on t<=d/2<=b_+, giving b_+−b_−+d. At d=0 the off-diagonal block vanishes and |2(a−b)|<=2. The displayed pure witnesses give both signs for every d, including d=1. To invert, beta/2−d>0 for beta>2 so squaring is reversible and gives the stated interval. RESULT.md lines 46–84 suffice; the script was inspected but not run. Its frozen log records 1,720 rational witness evaluations and 12,000 samples, not a proof for all states.

value.rationale: For the exact witness already used in the swap-covariance obstruction, the result gives both a sharp lower and a sharp upper certification of exchange defect from violation, with no purity assumption. The loss of violation near maximal as well as zero exchange distance and the attained interior Tsirelson point are useful additional structure, not a claim concerning optimized axes.
